description: Add pytest tests for the 5 critical gaps identified in the test gap analysis: (1) temporal split no-overlap, (2) lag leakage check, (3) ground-truth isolation across all app packages, (4) pricing constraint compliance on stored DB data, (5) ETL idempotency. Also add the API contract test for TIE_TOLERANCE (KI-01). All tests are new files — no existing test files are modified. Independent of FEAT-001 (evaluation scripts) but should run after the DB is populated.
steps: Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline/tests/test_phase13_temporal_split.py with two tests: test_time_split_no_overlap (calls models.data_split.load_features() and time_split(), asserts split.train_end < split.test_start) and test_time_split_matches_metadata (asserts split dates and counts match metadata.json). Use dotenv load from data-pipeline/.env.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline/tests/test_phase13_lag_leakage.py with one test: test_lag_features_no_leakage (loads RFM data via features.weekly_aggregation.load_weekly_aggregates(get_engine()), loads feature CSV via models.data_split.load_features(), calls features.build_feature_table._run_leakage_test(df_features, df_weekly), asserts True return value).

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline/tests/test_phase13_gt_isolation.py with one test: test_no_ground_truth_in_app_packages. Grep with regex r'revenue_management_gt|true_elasticity|true_segment|gt_product_elasticity|gt_customer_segment|purchase_rate|basket_mean|basket_std' over all .py files in etl/, features/, models/, segmentation/, pricing/, explanations/, backend/routes/, backend/services/. ALLOWED_FILES = {'load_to_mysql.py', 'validate_segmentation.py', 'validate_pricing.py', 'db_connection.py'}. Assert no violations.

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline/tests/test_phase13_pricing_compliance.py with two tests: test_all_stored_recommendations_satisfy_constraints (queries pricing_recommendation from DB, loops over all 50 rows, calls check_margin and check_max_change from pricing.constraints, asserts zero violations) and test_all_recommendations_have_negative_elasticity (asserts all elasticity values < 0).

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/data-pipeline/tests/test_phase13_etl_idempotency.py with three tests: test_forecast_features_row_count_stable (queries COUNT(*) twice, asserts equal and >0), test_core_table_row_counts_nonzero (asserts product=50, customer=1000, product_elasticity=50, customer_rfm_segment=1000), test_no_duplicate_product_ids_in_pricing_recommendation (asserts COUNT(*) == COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)).

Create /Users/kanishkbagzai/Revenue-Management-Project/revenue-management-project/backend/tests/test_phase13_api_contract.py with one test: test_binding_constraint_includes_tie_tolerance (uses existing 'client' fixture from conftest.py, queries /api/pricing/recommendations?page_size=200, collects all binding_constraint values, asserts each is in valid set including TIE_TOLERANCE as per KI-01 finding).

findings: All 6 new test files created (no existing test or application files modified). Verification in this sandbox (no MySQL installed, no .env/credentials, no full project venv; built a minimal venv with pytest+pandas+numpy+python-dotenv to run the non-DB tests): test_phase13_temporal_split.py PASSES 2/2 (CSV-only, no DB); test_phase13_gt_isolation.py PASSES 1/1 (static grep). The 4 DB-dependent files (test_phase13_lag_leakage.py, test_phase13_pricing_compliance.py, test_phase13_etl_idempotency.py, backend/test_phase13_api_contract.py) collect cleanly and are marked pytest.mark.skipif(not DB credentials) so they SKIP here ('requires live MySQL + DB credentials') and RUN for full-stack teams. GT-isolation finding (KI-09): implemented exactly per the FEAT-002 4-file ALLOWED_FILES hard rule, the test flagged GT references in etl/cleaning.py, etl/validation.py, and pricing/validate_elasticity.py. Operator decision (Option A): these are legitimate GT-handling files in the ETL/validation chain, so ALLOWED_FILES was expanded to include them with documented rationale (cleaning.py = ETL GT-routing prep feeding load_to_mysql.py; validation.py = ETL data-quality check on GT fields; validate_elasticity.py = validation hook via get_gt_engine(), sibling of the allowed validate_pricing/segmentation). No application code was changed. Documented as KI-09 in docs/known-issues.md and in docs/test_report.md. NOTE: full existing-suite 'no regressions' check could not be run here (minimal venv lacks xgboost/scikit-learn/flask/etc.); changes are additive (new files only + docs + this json), so no existing test or app behaviour is affected.
